speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand what's going on, can you tell me how old you are and if you've noticed any bleeding from your gums or nose? I'd also like to know if your leg pain is in your joints or the bones themselves.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count: Hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL, Leukocyte Count 63,000/mm3 (elevated), Platelet Count 27,000/mm3 (decreased). Peripheral Smear: Findings consistent with circulating immature blast cells.

speaker: Doctor
text: The blood tests show a very high white blood cell count with immature cells, low platelets, and anemia, which strongly suggests acute leukemia. I will now request a bone marrow biopsy to confirm the specific type of leukemia and guide treatment. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Bone Marrow Aspirate: Predominantly immature cells that are positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of CD10, CD19, and TdT-positive blasts confirms a diagnosis of B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. I will now request medical images to assess for any complications or organ involvement. REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text: The immunophenotype is definitive for B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
